svg.title: Umbra vs Playwright on Northwind Ops
svg.desc: Measured 2026-10-13 02:33 on a MacBookPro18,3 (Apple M1 Pro, 8 cores, 16 GB), macOS 27.0.1 (26A434). One-minute load average 2.66 at the start and 9.72 at the end (five-minute 4.81): no other lane's suites were running at the start, but something else started in roughly the last minute, when the Playwright WebKit rows (run last) were running. Against the earlier run (load 5.6 to 10.8), those rows are the same or faster (eval aside: 0.3 to 0.4 ms), except warm navigate, which went from 6.7 to 13 ms. Umbra's socket navigate made the same jump (7.1 to 13 ms) while load was still low, so the WebKit navigate change isn't the load spike; Chromium stayed at 6.5 ms. umbra 0.2.0 built from 4f879a5 (HEAD moved to e0b33a3 during the run; that commit changes only docs, so Sources, Makefile and Info.plist are identical); Playwright 1.62.1 with chromium 151.0.7922.34 and webkit 26.5. Each cell is p50 / p95 in milliseconds over 20 timed runs, after 2 untimed warm-up runs (the two cold rows have none: every run is cold). Every run is checked afterward (untimed): the page loaded, the switch flipped, the field holds the value, the images loaded or were blocked.
